SOURCE:
Outcome 6: Time of Observed Maximum Plasma Concentration (Tmax) of PF-06952229 (Part 1A)
Description: Tmax was defined as time to maximum observed concentration. Observed directly from data as time of first occurrence.
Time frame: 0 (pre dose), 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 6 and 12 hours (post dose) on Day 1 and 7 of cycle 1, 0 (pre dose), 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 6 and 12 hours (post dose) on Day 1 of cycle 2.
Analysis population: Participants with advanced/metastatic tumors in PF-06952229 single agent dose escalation phase, who had sufficient information to estimate at least 1 of the PK parameters of interest. Here, "number analyzed" signifies participant evaluable for each row.
